name: How should I prepare my home before a kitchen upgrade begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before a kitchen upgrade begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before construction begins, pack away all dishes, cookware, and pantry items, and establish a temporary cooking space in an adjacent room. Set up a microwave, coffee maker, and small refrigerator away from the work zone so daily routines can continue. Clearing hallways and access routes protects your home and gives the work crew clear paths to bring in lumber, drywall, and tile without damaging surrounding walls or flooring.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pack away all kitchen contents, set up a temporary meal station elsewhere in the home, and clear pathways for tools and building materials.
